name: Shoujo no Kimochi ~Onna no Ko Datte, Ecchi da mon!~
original_name: 少女のきもち～おんなのこだって、エッチだもん！～
source:
The protagonist, a student at the private Kashoin Academy, is a recent transfer student.
While enjoying school life to a certain extent, he also begins to feel uneasy about being treated like a guest.
Then, the protagonist is forcefully appointed to the executive committee for the school festival's signature event, the Miss School Festival Contest.
Though hesitant, he accepts.
However, not all of the girls in question readily agree to participate.
Last year's winner is Sakuragawa Yui, a quiet classmate.
Nanase Ruki, an upperclassman who feels a burning rivalry with Yui.
Tachibana Kanan and Kanon are cute but hard to read twins in the lower class.
Mutou Sayaka, a beautiful and intelligent upperclassman.
And then there's Odagiri Sara, a beautiful female teacher with a nice body, and Mizusaki Aori, a mysterious classmate who loves solitude.
When his younger sister, Miona, also says she wants to participate, the protagonist is at a loss.
Will he be able to persuade girls with different personalities and backgrounds to make the beauty pageant a success?
And who will be crowned school queen?
